notes.title: 🌟 Exclusive New Avatars for Combo Bombo Now Available! 🌟
notes.notes:
We've designed some exclusive avatars for our game!

 To access and set your new avatars, simply follow these easy steps:

[olist]
[*] Launch Steam and sign in to your account.
[*] Add [b]Combo Bombo[/b] to your library.
[*] Head over to your profile by clicking on your current profile picture in the upper-right corner and click "View my profile".
[*] Click the "Edit Profile" button.
[*] Under "Avatar", click "See All" under your avatars and browse to the "Combo Bombo" under "Your Game Avatars".
[*] Choose your favorite avatar from our collections.
[*] Scroll down and click "Save Changes" to confirm your new avatar.
[/olist]

notes.title: Finally we're on Steam!
notes.notes:
